Loop diuretic treatment was adjusted; check the discharge prescription and renal monitoring plan.
Cardiology and GP review requested within one week, with daily weights and safety-netting for worsening breathlessness.
Review weight, oxygen saturation, fluid status and renal profile, and confirm home support.
